Just for fun! \

::: {style="margin-left: 2em;"}
Stats are often mentioned during NFL broadcasts, and I often have questions.

I'm curious to learn more about the evolution of analytics in the NFL, how do [sabermetric](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sabermetrics)-like approaches get translated to this more complicated football context?\

And my team is finally relevant and exciting, [BEAR DOWN CHICAGO BEARS!](https://www.chicagobears.com/)🐻⬇️🏈
:::

So let's starting exploring NFL data, make some fun graphs, and practice quick-turnaround small-scale write ups (and maybe, eventually, use this to try to learn some new data skills and get into some more complicated football analytics). \
